output_full:
ergoweb.com — Force Guidelines – Ergoweb LLC — https://ergoweb.com/force-guidelines/
(found by the search; not opened or cited)
Elena Ruiz — Human Factors & Single-Operator Safety said about it: I take from Carts: Push/Pull Guidelines (E77) that sustained rolling force should drop to 25 pounds or less, from Force Guidelines – Ergoweb LLC (E78) that maximum two-handed sustained push-pull is 24 pounds, and from 3arm Solutions Help Manufacturers Maintain Safe Limits of Force Exertion (E80) that shoulder-height push is limited to 110 N, which all sit far below about 209 N pull and about 188 N hold from the tri-star climb over steps: cluster rotation and operator pull estimate (E23) with ratio about 1.45 from the ratio of downhill hold to female sustained pull limit (E59), about 19.2 kg in the hands from the hand-hold mass equivalent for 188 N stair hold (E83) like carrying a water crate all the way down, so the disc plus tooth hold at about 67.0 N m from the locked cluster holding torque and disc clamp on steep stair (E51) must carry it.
